sections.html: For the first time ever, a species of large freshwater crab from Paraguay has been imported. The animals have a shell width of about 5-8 cm. Together with the legs these crabs are larger than a man's hand. They most probably belong to the species Trichodactylus kensleyi. The generic name means "hairy finger". The hairs on the lower segments of the legs are clearly visible in the pictures.

Crabs are very entertaining animals in the aquarium. They seem to be quite intelligent and display a great number of interesting behaviours. However, one must keep in mind that crabs are also great destructors. They tend to try any inhabitant of their tank – plants as well as animals – to see if it is edible. And these crabs are very pugnacious towards conspecifics.
